message.reasoning_content:
Note: empty columns case — export_csv([{"a": 1}], []) → "\r\n\r\n". So each record is just CRLF, header is CRLF too. Interesting: header with no columns = "" then CRLF, and each row produces an empty line. But wait — "Ignore unselected fields": with empty columns, each row yields just CRLF. That's what the test says.

Note in test_missing_and_none: row {"a": None, "c": 3}, columns ["a","b"] → "a,b\r\n,\r\n" — a is None → empty, b missing → empty. Good.

Implement export_csv. Edge cases: values containing comma, quote, CR, LF → quote and double quotes. Non-string values → str(value). Keys must be strings; check duplicates via a set while preserving order.

Minimal quoting: quote only when the field contains comma, quote, CR, or LF.

Empty columns edge: rows each produce just CRLF. Actually with zero columns, each record is "" + "\r\n". Header also "\r\n". So output is "\r\n" * (1 + len(rows)). But with generators we don't know len; just iterate.

Write implementation.
